Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AVGO.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $2.96 per share.
Revenue guidance of $41.3 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2020.
We generated $1.9 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. Operating income reached $11.7 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 122 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
